name: 100bpm_click_quarters_play_16ths
description: Roadmap 1.3's own case. The metronome clicks quarters at 100 BPM (600 ms apart), the player plays clean 16ths (150 ms apart) with 5 ms of jitter, electric guitar. Keyed to the click the refractory is 450 ms and two notes in four are never heard; keyed to the player it is 112.5 ms and all of them are. 16 bars so the four beats the inference needs before it can lock are a small share of the pass.
